question: Select the most appropriate option for blank (4)
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**found**" indicates the presence or existence of something. (पाया गया)
 
• In the context of the passage**, "found in whole grains"** suggests that B vitamins are present in whole grains.
 
• The other options: "**founded**," "**finding**," and "**find**" do not fit the context appropriately as they do not convey the correct grammatical meaning.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *The B vitamins found__ in whole grains also help your body convert food into energy.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Founded (स्थापित)**: means having been established or set up.
 
• **Finding (खोज)**: means discovery of something.
 
• **Find (पाना)**: means to discover or perceive by chance or unexpectedly.
